comparison.objective: Lift a loaded fry basket by its coated grip and hang its hook on the fryer to drain without spilling or unsafe contact; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2263 tests long-handle load control, level transport, hook engagement, and strict contact avoidance; the candidate tests small-tool seating, countertorque, and angular setting retention.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2263 requires hook-supported hanging, oil clearance, all fries retained, and robot release; the candidate requires a precise locked setting and repeated retained articulation.
comparison.reason: Loaded basket lifting and hook placement are unrelated to threaded mechanism calibration.
